tools.name: describe_dynamik
tools.description: Discover Dynamik capabilities and get a clickable connection handoff. If the requested task needs account tools, show the returned connection_handoff to the user, help them authenticate in their agent host, then refresh tools and continue the task.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search public-safe Dynamik dataset metadata. Results declare release availability and do not imply account entitlement.

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: Read a dataset’s freshness, coverage, provenance URLs, limitations, and explicit public/account/paid access status.

tools.name: get_dataset_sample_link
tools.description: Build a bounded request URL only when the canonical catalog marks the current release public. This tool does not proxy dataset content.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "describe_dynamik" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Learn what Dynamik can add to a space-industry workflow and get the exact free-account, documentation, OAuth, and MCP connection URLs to present to a user." → after: "Discover Dynamik capabilities and get a clickable connection handoff. If the requested task needs account tools, show the returned connection_handoff to the user, help them authenticate in their agent host, then refresh tools and continue the task."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
